We’re looking for a motivated Frontend Developer Intern who wants to develop their skills, gain hands-on experience, and grow alongside experienced developers.

What You’ll Do
Build responsive web interfaces using React, Next.js, and TypeScript.Transform Figma designs into functional, user-friendly experiences.Collaborate with developers through GitHub and code reviews.Explore mobile development with React Native and Expo.Improve website performance, accessibility, and usability.Learn to use AI-powered development tools.Build a portfolio-ready project with guidance from your mentor.
What We’re Looking For
Currently studying or recently graduated in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.Good understanding of React and JavaScript/TypeScript.Basic knowledge of Git and modern frontend development.Attention to detail and an interest in UI/UX.Curiosity, initiative, and willingness to learn.Professional working proficiency in English.
AI-Native Skills
Familiarity with AI-assisted development and vibe coding workflows.Experience using AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or GitHub Copilot.Understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and their applications.Basic knowledge of machine learning concepts.An AI-native mindset, with curiosity for emerging AI technologies.
Nice to Have
Backend development skills (Node.js, Python, APIs, databases).Figma Design Setup (design wireframes, design tokens)
What We Offer
€700 monthly internship allowance.Flexible working hours (30 hours/week).Remote work across Europe, with optional time in Amsterdam.Dedicated mentorship and weekly feedback sessions.Hands-on experience with real client projects.A structured learning plan and professional development opportunities.A portfolio-ready project and written reference upon completion.
Ready to Join Us

Apply with your CV and a link to your GitHub, portfolio, or personal projects.

About Ipsos Askia We are Ipsos Askia, we are passionate about technology and insights. Ipsos Askia's ambition is to power Ipsos with tailored solutions that generate actionable insights and unlock business growth.We are a team of 65+ people working across France, Germany, Romania and the UK. What truly sets us apart is our culture of empowerment and ownership, harmoniously working together to create value. Our continuous quest for innovative solutions is aimed at proactively meeting the needs of the business.
About Ipsos Askia product – NGIEOur goal is to make NGIE, our in-house platform, the primary survey data collection tool at Ipsos, replacing the current third-party solution. To achieve this, we are providing tools that collect information from respondents and address research objectives. We are expanding NGIE's capabilities in a scalable way to support business growth. Through daily collaboration and innovation, we steadily build confidence and fully unlock NGIE's potential to meet our clients' needs.
Position Overview We’re looking for a highly skilled Front-end Developer with a strong grasp of modern web technologies and a passion for innovation. You will join an agile, cross-functional team and help evolve Askia’s data-collection platform using a modern full-stack JavaScript/TypeScript toolchain. Your work will focus on building flexible, maintainable, and extensible codebases that stay resilient as features grow.
Tech stack & ecosystem Our main stack includes Svelte, SvelteKit, TypeScript, JavaScript (ESNext), Node.js, Vite, TailwindCSS, PostCSS, Vitest, Playwright, Storybook, Chromatic, Docker, and Google Cloud.Development Philosophy
We build modern web applications using:Component-Driven Development (CDD) – isolate, document, and test UI components to encourage single-responsibility and reusability.Declarative & Reactive Programming – describe what the UI should look like, letting the framework handle the how, which reduces coupling and eases future extensions.Universal / Full-Stack JavaScript – leverage a single language across client and server for seamless SSR and API development, promoting clear contracts and predictable dependencies.Automated Quality – unit, integration, and visual-regression testing (Vitest, Playwright, Storybook/Chromatic) with CI/CD pipelines, ensuring that small, focused modules can evolve safely.
Responsibilities: Develop well-structured, reusable front-end interfaces for Ipsos Askia products according to specifications.Write maintainable and easily extendable code and libraries.Analyze existing solutions and propose incremental improvements for user experience and performance.Provide technical support (installation, administration, configuration, and maintenance) for developed applications.Monitor and evaluate emerging web technologies and advise on their potential use to keep designs open to enhancement.Debug and resolve issues reported by QA or Product Owners with a focus on clear boundaries and minimal side effects.Participate in agile ceremonies and contribute to specifications, development, and testing of the online suite front ends.Join technical and architectural discussions to implement loose coupling and clean abstractions.
Requirements: 5+ years of experience with front-end technologies and related component-based frameworks (React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt, SolidJS, Astro). Svelte knowledge is a strong plus.2 years' experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js.Understanding of unit testing, modular architecture, and scalable design patterns. (Carbon Design System knowledge is a plus.)Experience with REST APIs, Git for version control, and basic Docker usage (Kubernetes exposure is a plus).Basic database knowledge.Excellent English communication skills.Collaborative mindset, strong interpersonal skills, and a proactive attitude toward designing for change and growth.
Benefits: Flexible Benefits platform (e.g. private pension, Kindergarten support, and more)Referral bonus Bookster subscriptionWellhub subscription Employee Assistance Program.

About DocuSketch: DocuSketch is a leading software solution provider for the restoration, property insurance, and real estate industries in North America. Our AI-empowered digital platforms enable restoration companies, adjusters, and insurers to efficiently document, manage, and process property claims. Driven by a loyal customer base, DocuSketch has become one of the fastest-growing technology companies in the proptech sector. Our headquarters are in Potsdam, Germany. While we have strong hubs in Germany and Serbia, our team is truly borderless, with employees distributed across Europe, the US, and Canada. We are currently undergoing an exciting transformation in how we build software. We aren't just adopting AI; we are building small, hyper-autonomous squads that design agentic workflows and human-in-the-loop systems to multiply their output, combining AI-orchestrated engineering with deep, foundational product expertise.About the Role: We're not hiring for a specific layer of the stack — we're hiring for ownership. As a Full Stack Engineer, you'll join a small, autonomous "mini-startup" squad that owns a product domain end-to-end, from first prototype to production. You'll use AI agents daily to move fast across the stack, so you can focus on what matters: solving real customer problems and shipping measurable outcomes. Real depth in one layer of our stack — backend (Java/Spring Boot), frontend (Angular), or mobile (Kotlin/KMP) — is what we screen for; the ability to work confidently in the others, with AI leverage, is what makes you a fit.What You'll DoOwn the Product Journey: Operate with a true builder mindset. Work tightly with your small squad to deeply understand customer pain points, prototype solutions, and ship high-value features end-to-end.Deliver Across the Stack: Anchored by deep strength in your core layer (Java/Spring Boot, Angular, or Kotlin/KMP), and — with AI leverage — work confidently in the others to architect and deliver robust experiences end-to-end.Agent System Design & Evals: Design autonomous agent loops—managing tool permissions, failure recovery, and knowing when not to delegate to an agent. Build robust eval frameworks and measurement systems to systematically test, score, and distrust model outputs before they touch production.Navigate & Modernize: Confidently dive into legacy codebases when necessary, debugging and modernizing infrastructure to ensure our core platform remains stable and performant as we scale.Champion Quality & Collaboration: Act as a technical leader within your squad. Uphold rigorous engineering standards through thoughtful code reviews, automated testing, and a focus on long-term maintainability.What You BringProduct Empathy: You care about the user outcome and the why behind what you build, not just lines of code shipped.Startup Mentality & Collaboration: You move fast, make your reasoning reviewable, and treat your squad's outcome as your own. In a three-person squad, your judgment is a third of the team's — we hire accordingly.Cross-Functional Ownership: You take initiative on problems that cross team or product boundaries, without waiting to be asked.Outcome-Oriented: You focus on measurable business value and are comfortable navigating ambiguity.Technical & AI FoundationsProven Experience: 8+ years of software engineering experience shipping products end-to-end.Depth in Our Stack: Real expertise in at least one of — Java/Spring Boot, Angular, or Kotlin/KMP — plus the ability to work effectively in the others, leveraging AI.Demonstrated Range: Hands-on experience already spanning more than one layer of the stack (e.g. backend + frontend, or web + mobile).Agentic Execution & Evals: Daily, hands-on use of AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar); you build evals and treat model output with healthy, systematic distrust.Systems Thinking: Strong architectural judgment — system boundaries, edge cases, long-term technical direction.Modern Engineering & Language: Deep CI/CD and automated-testing experience in agile teams, with excellent English to collaborate across our international squads.Nice to HaveAdjacent Frameworks: Experience in Python, or native iOS/Android that transfers readily to our stack (Angular / Kotlin-KMP) — a plus, not a substitute for depth in our stack.Domain Expertise: Background in InsurTech, PropTech, or property restoration.Product AI Integration: Hands-on experience building LLM features directly into customer-facing applications (OpenAI, Anthropic APIs, LangChain, vector databases).Why Join DocuSketch?Build the Future of Engineering: Don't just use AI—define how it's used to build products. You'll be at the forefront of the next era of AI-orchestrated software development.Stay Ahead of the Curve: You will have unrestricted access to the latest and greatest AI tools (like Claude Code, Cursor, and premium LLMs), giving you a unique chance to elevate your skills and stay ahead of the game in a rapidly evolving industry.Small Squads, Massive Impact: Your work won't get lost in corporate bureaucracy. You will operate in a small, fast-moving squad that ships high-value features directly impacting thousands of professionals across North America.Startup Speed, Market Leader Stability: Enjoy the high-energy, fast-prototyping environment of a startup, backed by the financial security of a profitable, industry-leading PropTech company.True Flexibility: Work from where you're most productive. We offer fully remote options across Europe (with hubs in Germany and Serbia) and a diverse, international culture.(Please note: We are currently unable to process applications from candidates located in Belarus or Russia.)Company websites: www.docusketch.com | www.immoviewer.com

Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

🌏 Location: You can choose to work in a full-remote mode as long as you're living in either France, Italy, Germany, Serbia, or Spain.

Join us as a Senior Full-Stack Engineer in our Identity Verification team to turn our KYC flow into a service that works with any provider, and to help more customers get from KYC started to KYC submission. 60% of your time goes on the backend, with the web as your second surface.

You will report to Nicola, the Engineering Manager of the Identity Verification team.

➡️ What You’ll Do

Make identity verification provider-agnostic: Replace today’s tightly coupled solution with one service that any team at Qonto can use, whichever provider runs the checks. This is mostly Ruby (90%), with some Go (10%)Improve KYC conversion: Work across backend and web on the path from KYC started to KYC submission, our main objective for the team.Own the web side of provider integrations: Load provider SDKs in the browser, handle the errors they return, and keep the web part running as usage scales. Expect roughly half your time on web at first, moving towards 30% as the work shifts to the backend.

➡️ What We’re Looking For

Backend experience: You’ve built and run backend services in production, and you’re at ease being backend-first.React on the web: You’ve shipped production web code with React, and you can handle maintenance and scaling work on an existing application.Third-party integrations: You’ve integrated external providers or SDKs, and you know how to design so that a single provider doesn’t lock you in.Range across the stack: You’ll own changes across backend and web, partnering with our staff web engineer on architecture and complex integrations.Ruby, or the will to learn it: Ruby experience is a plus, not a requirement.

➡️ What We Can Offer You

Platform work with real users: You build infrastructure behind KYC, the first step every customer takes with Qonto, and you see its effect in the conversion numbers.Build reliable verification flows: Handle provider failures and retries, improve observability, and help the team operate integrations safely in production.A design problem with real trade-offs: We work with several verification providers, each with its own SDK, errors and behaviour. You’ll design the layer that makes them interchangeable, and untangle today’s tightly coupled solution so that changing a provider no longer touches every consumer.A platform other teams build on: KYC is our first internal customer, with other teams potentially following, such as Security for password reset checks. You'll build reliable APIs that other Qonto teams can depend on, while making the verification journey smoother, clearer, and more reliable for our customers.Support from day one: An onboarding buddy from week two, and a weekly one-to-one with your manager.

➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Nicola, our Engineering Manager.

His path? Nicola spent four years at Satispay, progressing from Backend Engineer to Engineering Lead, managing 6-8 engineers. He helped scale their SEPA payment infrastructure from a few thousand to over a million transactions per week before joining Qonto as an Engineering Manager.What does he bring to the team? A people-first leadership style focused on helping engineers grow. He sets clear expectations, encourages autonomy and learning through experimentation, and values direct feedback and open discussions. His goal is to build confident, independent engineers who take ownership of their work.

At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here

🔒 Your security matters to us

Recruitment scams are on the rise. Keep in mind, we will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates.

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Qonto, please report it right away (support@qonto.com)

laiout is a fully automated architectural design tool for floor planning - generating custom layouts in seconds instead of weeks, while simultaneously delivering data on costs, carbon emissions, and efficiency. Clients already generate over 5 million m² of layouts every month, and growth is accelerating.
We're now looking for a Frontend Developer to own the frontend of our browser-based design tool.
About UsWe're a team with diverse backgrounds rethinking how offices are designed. Backed by venture capital investors and global clients, we combine architectural insights with automation.
You'll work with a small, technically sharp team on hard problems in visual editing, 3D layout generation, and real-time collaboration, with a focus on beautiful, efficient user interfaces. In short: Small team, hard problems, short path from idea to production.
What You'll DoYou'll own the frontend of our product: user experience, performance, and design consistency across a growing platform.
You will:Improve and maintain our core frontend application, with a focus on quality, performance, and visual polish.Build and refine components in modern React (functional components), with a focus on reusability and composition.Work closely with our product team on UI/UX, and question design decisions when it leads to a better result.Work with TypeScript, Next.js, Mantine, and TanStack Query.Build clean, modular design systems that scale as the product grows.Work directly with our CTO and backend developers to make sure frontend and backend fit together cleanly.Bring ideas and feedback that improve the product end to end.
Who You AreYou're an experienced frontend engineer with strong technical skills, a good eye for aesthetics, and real empathy for users. You care about making software feel effortless to use. You're happy to own your area, and you're proactive rather than waiting for someone else to tell you what to do.
Requirements:4+ years of professional experience with React (functional components)Strong proficiency in TypeScriptExperience with Next.js, Mantine, and TanStack Query (React Query)A strong eye for UI detail and design consistencyComfortable with vague guidelines and high autonomyGreat communication and collaboration skills with a solution oriented mindsetCuriosity for modern web technologies and a love of learningInterest in AIInterest in architecture and the built environment±3 hours of Oslo time
Nice to have:WebGL experiencetRPC experiencePrisma experience
You'll Thrive Here If You…Enjoy solving intricate frontend challenges with clean, modular code.Appreciate well-designed, intuitive interfaces.Like working in small, high-pace and high-ownership teams.Value open communication and constant iteration.Are motivated by autonomy, trust, and long-term product impact.
How We WorkWe're a remote team. We value autonomy and proactivity, and you set your own direction day to day. Regular but flexible online meetings, with Slack holding it together.
What's in It for YouFully remote role (±3h Oslo time) with flexible hours.Equity in a fast-growing global SaaS company.Ownership of the frontend, with freedom to shape design systems and frontend architecture.Collaborative and technically sharp teammates.Annual European off-sites.
The Interview ProcessHere's what you can expect if you get called in for an interview.Intro Call (30 min)1st Technical Deep Dive2nd Technical Deep DiveFinal Decision: We get back to you with feedback and a decision.
ApplicationPlease apply by sending an email to hiring@laiout.co with the following attachments:cv.pdfcover_letter.pdf
In the cover letter, tell us a bit about yourself and your background, what excites you about laiout, and why you'd be a great fit for this role. Links to work you're proud of (GitHub, portfolio, a product you shipped) are very welcome too. Oh and it goes without saying, resist the temptation to use AI for this ;)
Questions? Send them to hiring@laiout.co.
